messages:
Anna (CEO): Quick follow-up from todays all-hands: short thread for sharp Qs about mission and how we tell the story vs cloud providers. Keep replies concise.
Sam (Head of Sales): Sales ask: one-line positioning for discovery calls vs cloud-managed endpoints?
Jai (VP Product): 'Redwood gives you predictable, production-grade inference with the same API across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.'
Sam (Head of Sales): Good. Add why that matters in one sentence for execs.
Jai (VP Product): 'That consistency + rollout controls and cost levers means faster time-to-scale and fewer outages in production.'
Maya (Eng-Infra): Ops question: are fallbacks enabled by default for hosted customers? Need clarity for support.
Anna (CEO): Hosted: compatible fallbacks in-region are default unless customer pins. Dedicated/Private honor pins and region constraints; we'll update the support playbook.
Lina (Legal): For Private pilots, we need a checklist: KMS integration, data residency, and audit log scope. I'll circulate a template.
OpsBot: incident-monitor: no active incidents in infra cluster east-1.
Anna (CEO): Thanks all. Action items: Jai -> 1-pager + one-liner scripts; Lina -> Private pilot checklist; Maya -> update support playbook. Post updates here when ready. :thumbsup:
